title: Ship the cost model as a checkable artifact
statement: A minimality claim "cost 4 under model M" is meaningless unless M is pinned and machine-readable, including the additivity side conditions. Kilobytes; nearly free; nobody does it. Effort estimate: weeks.
sources: research/surveys/ -- see the per-domain reports for citations and encoding estimates
